verdict.rationale: The agency publishes forms and a defined role for third-party representation: an Appointment of New Registered Agent form and a Commercial Registered Agent registration for agents representing more than 10 companies. Nothing in the evidence defines what such a third party may or may not file or sign on an entity's behalf. Missing for 10: a published scope of what a registered agent or authorized filer may and may not do, documentation of which signatures must stay personal to officers or members, authorization or consent forms for third-party filers, and any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
